send.title: Send to carriers
send.description: Pick the carriers you want offers from. Only your accepted connections can be asked.
send.description-all: Pick the transporters you want a price from: your own, or any transporter on the portal. Awarding the load to one you are not connected to makes you partners.

message.label: Message (optional)
message.placeholder: Anything the carriers should know before quoting
message.hint: The same message goes to every carrier you picked.

accept.title: Book with this carrier?

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.description: Order {orderId} will be closed and the carriers you asked will be told.

note.label: Why is it being cancelled?
note.placeholder: E.g. the client called the load off
note.hint: At least {min} characters. This is the record of why the load went away.

add.title: Attach a document
add.description: PDF, JPG or PNG. It is filed against this order and both sides can read it.

errors.truck: Pick a truck from your fleet

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: Only drivers registered by your company can be sent

papers.title: Papers
papers.description: Appload checks these at the loading site, so they have to be on file before the truck leaves.
papers.error: The papers could not be loaded. Try again.
papers.pending-hint: Filed. Appload reviews it, and the truck can leave meanwhile.
papers.missing-hint: File one of these to send this truck.

loadingCheck.none: Nobody has checked the truck and the driver against what was dispatched. This move will be recorded as unchecked and the order will be flagged.
loadingCheck.partial: The loading check was left unfinished. This move will be recorded as unchecked and the order will be flagged.
loadingCheck.mismatch: The loading check found that the truck or the driver is not the one that was dispatched. Appload has to review it before the load can start.

note.label: What happened?
note.placeholder: Say what changed, in a line or two

document.format: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files are accepted.
